question: Does replacing the exact live scheduler's hand-tuned score with a learned evaluator define a distinct, currently measurable experiment?

score_flow.role: constructs only feasible phase-specific WAIT, bank, harvest, mine, chop, plant/conversion, and MOVE candidates; many branches return early
mixes categorical priority bands with travel, wait, rate, wood, denial-distance, conversion, and endgame terms

score_flow.layer: live filters and forced candidate-set rewrites
score_flow.role: chooses phase generator, applies protected-tree and TRAIN filters, can force door clearing or external idle, then freezes the candidate map
single-worker argmax or exhaustive compatible two-worker summed-score maximum
collision/path logic may replace selected MOVE commands; bookkeeping does not restore the original rank
may replace the starter command, protect the mother, and resolve conflicts again independently of inner candidate scores

authority.score_can_change: ordinary command or compatible command pair on every state where alternatives exist
authority.locality_conclusion: Despite retaining the grammar, a learned score can select a different command pair repeatedly and therefore replace the whole trajectory. Same action space is not a bounded authority guarantee.

interpretations.label: exact deterministic source score
interpretations.policy_effect: none if exact; approximation error otherwise

interpretations.label: resident command or pair
interpretations.policy_effect: clones the current ceiling, with autoregressive approximation risk

interpretations.label: one alternative followed by resident continuation
interpretations.prior_or_dependency: D16-D19 resident residual closure; D41d-D44 continuation/value closure as corroboration

interpretations.interpretation: fit broad candidate values and replace the score globally
interpretations.label: offline terminal counterfactual or on-policy terminal return

interpretations.interpretation: fit compatible-pair continuation value as a residual to the live sum-score
interpretations.label: terminal value of one or more exact live compatible-pair alternatives
interpretations.policy_effect: bounded only after coverage and intervention budget are measured
interpretations.prior_or_dependency: peer-owned N4 Phase A and possible separately authorized Phase B

interpretations.interpretation: add spatial planes to D172 option evaluation
interpretations.label: D172 exact option counterfactuals
interpretations.policy_effect: budget-1 macro option, not live candidate-score replacement

binding_evidence.d18: 0/40 compact resident primitive-residual spatial recipes passed
binding_evidence.d19: larger capacity and oracle opponent identity also failed; single-state terminal-advantage distillation closed
binding_evidence.d36: four resident-anchored joint overlay epochs gained 10.633 margin versus the frozen 25 floor and closed further overlay work
binding_evidence.d41a: learned score imitation reached 84.386-84.960% while an exact decoder reproduced 85047/85047 decisions
binding_evidence.d41e: the strongest prospective D40 residual selector gained 4.116 versus the 5 floor and stopped before Stage B
binding_evidence.d42_d44: context-complete sign selection, sparse closed-loop PPO, and actor-score reuse failed discrimination gates
binding_evidence.d79: all 32 random broad target scorers changed 64/64 task hashes and became global controllers
binding_evidence.d83: snapshot response-value ridge gained 1.188 and failed selection gates
binding_evidence.d84: short exact online response search missed both value and latency conjunctions
binding_evidence.d172: exact dense option labels existed, but 0/4 fitted selectors were admitted
binding_evidence.n6: changing one live score weight altered 53.32-73.83% of task command streams; LOW lost 0.754 and HIGH gained only 0.559 with 4/8 positive families

decision.reason: Score/action imitation cannot establish improvement; exact-resident single-state advantage distillation and broad scorer/value families are closed; H10a is separate. The only non-closed exact-live evaluator label is compatible-pair continuation value, whose surface and ownership are N4.
decision.successor: Do not create L3a. Wait for accepted N4 Phase A. If N4 closes, close L3 with it. If N4 and a separately authorized material Phase B clear, replace L2/L3 with one precisely bounded compatible-pair residual-evaluator item rather than two competing experiments.
